observations: Rat middle cerebral artery study comparing reactivity after 2 h focal ischemia with and without rtPA exposure.

entities.name: rtPA reduces postischemic dilation
observations: In ex-vivo rat MCA, ACh-evoked diameter increase at 10⁻⁵ mol/L was 8±2% after ischemia+rtPA (400 μg/mL), versus 17±3% after ischemia alone and 23±4% in controls; rtPA intensified attenuation of vasodilation.

Serotonin-mediated vasoconstrictor sensitivity was diminished after ischemia but not further worsened by rtPA; EC50 was 0.16±0.04 μmol/L with ischemia+rtPA versus 0.22±0.07 μmol/L with ischemia alone.
